name: Dr. Florian Lachner
headline: Staff UXR Manager at Google
summary: I'm a passionate mixed-methods UXR lead and manager with over 13 years of experience in the field of Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) and UX Research. Throughout my career I've led research programs at the intersections of human psychology, culturally sensitive design, privacy, regulation, and AI memory. Right now I manage and enable a globally distributed team of UX researchers working on personalization and AI.

positions.title: Staff UX Research Manager
positions.description: Leading and enabling a distributed team of UX Researchers across multiple locations and time zones. Focused on aligning research strategy, operationalizing workflows, and fostering a unified culture of insight-driven design and individual growth.

positions.title: Staff UX Researcher
positions.description: Leading UX research for multiple complex Chrome Trust & Safety areas shaping product strategy and business decisions. This involves driving cross-functional stakeholders alignment, translating business objectives into actionable user-centered insights, and conducting research programs that span ideation, foundational research, concept testing, and success measurement. My focus areas include privacy, AI, account/identity, child safety, and regulation. I work directly with multiple teams, including 5 product managers, 5 UX designers/writers, and 30+ engineers, as well as Chrome and T&S leadership. In addition, I've coached, mentored, and onboarded multiplen other UXRs.

positions.title: Senior UX Researcher Trust & Safety
positions.description: Leading UXR for various Chrome efforts including compliance and regulatory projects (e.g., Digital Markets Act), privacy (e.g., general availability of Privacy Sandbox APIs), sign-in and sync, as well as research with minors/kids and families.

positions.title: UX Researcher Chrome Privacy Sandbox
positions.description: Chrome UXR lead for the Privacy Sandbox initiative which aims to improve web privacy for users, while also giving publishers, creators and other developers the tools they need to build thriving businesses, ensuring a safe and healthy web for all.

positions.title: UX Researcher Chrome Trust & Safety
positions.description: Qualitative user research for Chrome privacy and security topics including cross-product/area alignment and strategy definition. I led research for Chrome Incognito Mode and Chrome Identity including sign-in/sync features and managed the research program for Chrome's multi profiles launch.
